governing_text: SchwingNet/LEVELCHECK_MODEL.md s4 (endpoint, primary configuration), s9 (freeze), s12 (M1/F1/D1), s13 (S1), s14 (automated reference), s15 (detector) -- frozen, not edited

primary.arm: held-out-transitional evaluation arm, clean start: level encoder initialised from public ImageNet weights (the only exempt ancestor) and trained, with the run heads, on the G3 train side of the frozen split (val side selects the epoch); no v8/v9 checkpoint in its chain; no G3 test person, no C-ArmLSpine and no COBRA person in any training root
primary.call: coupled (tools/alphabet_couple.py, std alphabets, posterior blend, classifier field `level`)

preprocess.orientation_net: off (--no-orient: frames upright by a device constant)

detector.name: det_g3_primary_s0
detector.design: one YOLO11m, 1024 px, classes vertebra + sacrum, vertebral-BODY truth (A28), G3 TRAIN side of every device (C-ArmLSpine, COBRA Elekta v1 + v3 body-window export, DeepFluoro, styled renders of TRAIN persons under TRAIN pose donors), G3 VAL side real frames for checkpoint selection, dc_P_pooled recipe (tools/devcorpus_train.py: 60 epochs, batch 8, patience 15, degrees 10, translate 0.1, scale 0.3, fliplr 0.5, mosaic 0.5, hsv_v 0.2), init = COCO yolo11m.pt (verified release)

lists.box_convention: vertebral BODY (A28) for every vertebra; whole-bone box for the sacrum
lists.leak_proof: SchwingNet/results/fig6/detector_g3_lists_check.json (PASS by two derivations + checkpoint gate; all 2,887 G3 test+hold persons overlap 0; T1/T2/T3 HELD OUT)

detector.validation_recall_note: G3 VALIDATION persons only (the detector's checkpoint-selection set); SchwingNet/results/fig6/DETECTOR_G3_VALIDATION.md

body_boxes.from: this detector (level_prototype.py --box-detector; class 0 vertebra = vertebral BODY box)
body_boxes.why: level_prototype accepts a box detector for bodies, so detect_v5z_final is not used for bodies in the primary variant; 0.25 is the tool's default box floor and the c0.25 validation operating point (vertebra recall 93.4-93.7 % COBRA, 87 % C-ArmLSpine); a body with no detection makes the frame wrong under s4, and the 0.74 floor is the SACRUM ANCHOR's (as the pre-G3 draft split the two: vertebra_boxes.conf 0.35, sacrum_anchor_min_conf 0.74). Chosen on validation numbers, never on a test person.

sacrum_anchor.from: this detector (class 1 sacrum, the most confident box)

keypoint_detector_still_loaded.role: loaded and leak-gated in every run (level_prototype default); boxes the bodies only in the LODO secondary variant

primary.frames: T2 COBRA real kV frames + T3 C-ArmLSpine real frames (s4: real frames only); T1 renders secondary

truth.rule: s4 reference standard, s14 R3: human-verified truth (verification/truth_frozen.csv + .sha256, tools/verification_pages.py freeze) first where a row exists; else the frozen automated reference (auto_truth.csv) where the rule ASSIGNED a subtype and every lumbar name; else the person is excluded from the primary analysis and counted in the flow diagram
truth.names: the reference alphabet at the body's ordinal counted up from the truth sacrum box (s3 convention i; the verification pages' P1 = first body above the sacrum); positional carry-over where the frame has no truth sacrum

rule.mode: per_subtype (no rule reached a PPV lower bound of 0.90 for every subtype it assigns)

human_truth_file.note: none exists at this write: the s14 automated reference alone assigns, and it certifies ORDINARY spines only; every transitional real-frame person stays unassigned (excluded, counted) unless a human reads them before release

T2_cobra_test_persons_159.note: 37 harvest-T13 and 1 harvest-L6 persons are ordinary under the reference (calibration PPV of ordinary 0.991, wrong truths L6 4 / T13 1 of 554); both analyses are produced (reference primary; harvest names labelled secondary), s9

T3_carmlspine_test_persons_13.reason: no reader could count on a lumbar-only CBCT (thoracolumbar junction not in the field)
T3_carmlspine_test_persons_13.consequence: T3 enters the primary analysis only after a human read is frozen

what_the_join_gives_at_this_write.source: SchwingNet/results/fig6/frozen/auto_truth.csv joined by person_key at this write; the job re-derives it

truth.harvest_names_analysis: fig6_score_<gate>_harvest.json: the set metas' SPINEPS+VERIDAH / CBCT-labeller names; labelled, secondary, not a reference standard
truth.three_carmlspine_L6: excluded from the primary analysis in advance (s4); descriptive via --truth-variant case42=L6,case121=L6,case136=L6

primary.eval_gate: tools/eval_gate.py check on every set x head x variant (encoder, head, detect_v5z_final, det_g3_primary_s0 / LODO detector) before the prototype runs, and the prototype gates every image; blinded gate: a refused set is not run

secondary._heads: seeds 1-2 at lambda 0 and the D1 dual-loss heads (lambda 1.0, seeds 0-2): each runs T1 oracle, T2 det, T3 det

lodo_detectors_variant.what: s15: 'detector never saw this device' -- the pre-G3 configuration, reported beside the primary with the s4 endpoint unchanged

bodies.note: keypoint detector, trained on films only (aasce, buu, csxa, mendeley, nhanes; SchwingNet/results/eval_gate/LINEAGE.md); it touched no test person of CTSP, VerSe, TotalSegmentator, COBRA or C-ArmLSpine (results/fig6/detector_exclusions.json)

sacrum_anchor.note: the LODO box detector that never saw the device it anchors on

secondary.det25: sacrum anchor at conf >= 0.25 (same prototype run as det74)
secondary.oracle: truth boxes, sacrum from the truth meta (naming apart from detection)
secondary.T1_renders: renders of TEST CT persons, oracle boxes (s4: renders are secondary)

scripts_sha256._note: sha256 with LF line endings (as deployed to the grid)
